name: Angel Cake
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: cream of tartar
ingredients.originalText: One teaspoonful of cream of tartar

ingredients.name: glass and a half of white powdered sugar
ingredients.originalText: One glass and a half of white powdered sugar

instructions.text: Put cream of tartar into flour, then sift five times
Beat whites of eleven eggs to stiff froth
Stir sugar into eggs by degrees, very lightly and carefully
Add flour, stirring quickly and lightly
Pour into clean, bright tin cake-dish which should not be buttered or lined
Bake at once in a moderate oven about forty minutes, testing with a broom splint
When done, turn cake-tin upside down with sides resting on tops of two saucers so air will pass under and over it

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Put cream of tartar into flour, then sift five times
2. Sift white powdered sugar separately
3. Beat whites of eleven eggs to stiff froth
4. Stir sugar into eggs by degrees, very lightly and carefully
5. Add vanilla extract
6. Add flour, stirring quickly and lightly
7. Pour into clean, bright tin cake-dish which should not be buttered or lined
8. Bake at once in a moderate oven about forty minutes, testing with a broom splint
9. When done, turn cake-tin upside down with sides resting on tops of two saucers so air will pass under and over it
